items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I first got in touch with George... he told me that he was responsible for me getting that tight with George... George Wein called me... asked me if I would be interested in doing some gigs with him.

ctx.x: No, not Charlie Bourgeois. An Englishman. I can't think of it... He was up in Boston when I first got in touch with George. In fact, he told me that he was responsible for me getting that tight with George.
